StoreProfile.title: StoreProfile
StoreProfile.description: Merchant store metadata and initialization state for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the store owner.

storeName.description: Display name of the store (1 to 60 characters).

ownerEmail.description: Optional email of the store owner.

catalogSeeded.description: Whether the starter catalog has already been initialized for this store.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the store profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the store profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A product item in the merchant's catalog and inventory.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the product owner.

imageKey.description: Optional bundled drawable key (e.g., headphones, coffee, backpack).

active.description: Whether the product is active and visible in the storefront.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: A completed or cancelled point-of-sale transaction with line items.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the seller.

customerName.description: Customer name or walk-in label (1 to 80 characters).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the sale.

items.description: Bounded list of 1 to 30 sold line-item maps.

totalCents.description: Total sale amount in cents (1 to 1000000000).

totalItems.description: Total unit count across all line items (1 to 10000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: User store profile and seeding state.

/users/{userId}/products/{productId}.description: Products belonging to the authenticated user's store.

/users/{userId}/sales/{saleId}.description: Sales transactions recorded by the authenticated user.
